question: Under which licence is the Human Protein Atlas released, and which publication (authors, journal, year and PubMed ID) does the atlas ask you to cite for its subcellular data?

tool_uses.name: web_search
tool_uses.input: {"query":"site:proteinatlas.org license Human Protein Atlas subcellular data cite publication PubMed"}

tool_uses.name: web_search

tool_uses.name: web_search

turns.text:
The Human Protein Atlas is released under the **Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) licence** for all copyrightable parts of its database. Third-party data may have separate restrictions.  
Source: https://www.proteinatlas.org/about/licence

For its **subcellular data**, the Atlas asks users to cite:

**Thul PJ et al., “A subcellular map of the human proteome.” _Science_ (2017). PubMed ID: 28495876.**  
Source: https://www.proteinatlas.org/about/licence
